name: Bradley Armand
original_name: ブラッドリー・アルマンド
source:
A very calm and polite gentleman but sometimes something seems suspicious about him.

He claims to be directionally challenged and can’t tell left from right.

[spoiler]The truth is that he's Bradley Armand butler. His real name is Yuri Kazuki Roshinof.[/spoiler]
